messages:
sam.green: Heads-up — NovaHealth POC ends next Fri. Can we confirm owner for final inventory + credential rotation? Need hosted API key revoke, dedicated pool drain, and DB snapshot TTL. cc @anya
anya: I can take the infra steps (pool drain + snapshots). Sam, need the list of resources and customer contact.
sam.green: I added the resource list: hosted API key id abc123, dedicated pool pool-nova-1, ephemeral DB creds user:nova_poc. Customer contact: julie@novahealth (internal alias nova-julie).
maria.k: For hosted keys we should do `POST /internal/keys/revoke` with body `{ "key_id": "abc123", "reason": "poc_end" }` — I'll run it after we confirm.
kevin: For the dedicated pool: plan = 1) stop new allocations 2) wait 30m for in-flight 3) snapshot model cache 4) drain and delete pool. I'll trigger drain at EOD Fri.
jordan.m: Data retention question from legal: Do we keep logs for 30 days or purge after handoff? They asked for minimal retention for POCs. Current default is 90-day. Can we temporarily set 30 for this POC?
anya: We can set retention to 30d for NovaHealth — need an ops ticket to lower retention before deletion window. I'll create one.
sam.green: Also need to rotate ephemeral DB creds — here's the one-off script I used earlier: ```ssh ops@db01 'psql -c "ALTER USER nova_poc WITH PASSWORD '\'$(openssl rand -hex 16)'\'';'``` we'll store new creds in their vault and then delete user after audit window.
maria.k: Suggest: don't delete DB user immediately — create readonly account for compliance to allow audits for 30d, then drop. Legal asked for an audit trail.
kevin: approved by legal via email. We'll rotate, snapshot, then mark for deletion after 30 days. I'll annotate the ticket and add snapshot timestamp.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline note: `pool-nova-1` draining started by kevin at 1768501800 :white_check_mark:
sam.green: Cool — action items: anya (create ops ticket to lower retention + schedule drain), maria.k (revoke hosted key post-check), kevin (drain & snapshot), jordan.m (confirm legal retention), sam.green (notify customer & confirm handoff). I'll send the offboarding email today :email:
anya: ops ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4521 — includes link to snapshot plan, retention change, and checklist :rocket:
maria.k: Revocation executed after confirmation. `key abc123` status -> revoked :lock:
sam.green: Thanks all. I'll close the thread when customer confirms receipt. :thumbsup:
